blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The father of the student behind the school shooting in a South Cotabato high school has been relieved from his post at the Department of Education (DepEd), agency officials said on Tuesday. During the House of Representatives’ plenary discussions on DepEd’s proposed budget for 2027, Davao de Oro Rep. Maria Carmen Zamora gave this update when asked by Akbayan Rep. Percival Cendaña about the agency’s response to the shooting incident at the Banga National High School last Friday — which claimed the lives of three students and injured six others.
